```{r setup, warning=FALSE}
  st_as_sf(coords = c("x", "y"), crs = 4326) %>%

add_xy <- function(dat) {
  coords <- st_coordinates(dat)
  dat %>%
    mutate(
      X = coords[,1],
      Y = coords[,2]
    )
}

extract_covariates <- function(dat_sf, covariate_stack) {
  vect_pts <- terra::vect(dat_sf)
  cov_vals <- terra::extract(covariate_stack, vect_pts)

  bind_cols(
    dat_sf %>% st_drop_geometry(),
    cov_vals %>% dplyr::select(-ID)
  ) %>%
    bind_cols(geometry = st_geometry(dat_sf)) %>%
    st_as_sf()
}

soil_SP_cov <- soil_prop_SP %>%
  add_xy() %>%
  extract_covariates(covariate_stack)

soil_COMP_cov <- soil_prop_COMP %>%
  add_xy() %>%
  extract_covariates(covariate_stack)
```

```{r model, warning=FALSE}
coords_SP <- st_coordinates(soil_prop_SP)
coords_COMP <- st_coordinates(soil_prop_COMP)

cutoff_SP <- max(dist(coords_SP)) / 2
cutoff_COMP <- max(dist(coords_COMP)) / 2

width_SP <- 100
width_COMP <- 100

make_resamples <- function(sf_data, n_iter = 50, train_frac = 0.7, base_seed = 20260326) {
  ids <- seq_len(nrow(sf_data))
  seeds <- base_seed + seq_len(n_iter)

  resamples <- vector("list", n_iter)

  for (i in seq_len(n_iter)) {
    set.seed(seeds[i])

    n_train <- floor(train_frac * length(ids))
    train_ids <- sort(sample(ids, size = n_train, replace = FALSE))
    test_ids <- setdiff(ids, train_ids)

    resamples[[i]] <- list(
      iteration = i,
      seed = seeds[i],
      train_ids = train_ids,
      test_ids = test_ids
    )
  }

  resamples
}


resamples_SP <- make_resamples(soil_SP_cov, n_iter = 50, train_frac = 0.7, base_seed = 20260326)
resamples_COMP <- make_resamples(soil_COMP_cov, n_iter = 50, train_frac = 0.7, base_seed = 20261326)

calc_metrics <- function(obs, pred) {
  tibble(
    n = length(obs),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MAE = mean(abs(obs - pred), na.rm = TRUE),
    R2 = cor(obs, pred, use = "complete.obs")^2,
    mean_error = mean(obs - pred, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

tune_rf_oob <- function(train_df, response, predictors, ntree = 500) {
  x_train <- train_df %>% select(all_of(predictors))
  y_train <- train_df[[response]]

  p <- length(predictors)
  mtry_grid <- unique(pmax(1, c(
    floor(sqrt(p)),
    floor(p / 4),
    floor(p / 3),
    floor(p / 2)
  )))

  fits <- purrr::map(mtry_grid, function(m) {
    set.seed(sample.int(1e6, 1))
    rf <- randomForest(
      x = x_train,
      y = y_train,
      ntree = ntree,
      mtry = m,
      importance = TRUE
    )

    tibble(
      mtry = m,
      oob_mse = tail(rf$mse, 1)
    )
  }) %>%
    bind_rows()

  best_mtry <- fits %>%
    slice_min(oob_mse, n = 1) %>%
    pull(mtry)

  list(
    best_mtry = best_mtry,
    tuning_table = fits
  )
}

fit_variogram_models <- function(vg) {
  vg_df <- as.data.frame(vg)

  init_nugget <- max(0, min(vg_df$gamma, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.5)
  init_sill <- max(vg_df$gamma, na.rm = TRUE)
  init_psill <- max(init_sill - init_nugget, 1e-6)
  init_range <- max(vg_df$dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 3

  candidate_models <- c("Sph", "Exp")

  fits <- purrr::map(candidate_models, function(m) {
    tryCatch({
      fit <- fit.variogram(
        vg,
        model = vgm(
          psill = init_psill,
          model = m,
          range = init_range,
          nugget = init_nugget
        )
      )

      if (any(!is.finite(fit$psill))) return(NULL)
      if (any(!is.finite(fit$range))) return(NULL)
      if (any(fit$range[fit$model != "Nug"] <= 0)) return(NULL)

      fit
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  })

  fits <- fits[!sapply(fits, is.null)]
  if (length(fits) == 0) return(NULL)

  sse <- sapply(fits, function(f) attr(f, "SSErr"))
  fits[[which.min(sse)]]
}

run_rf_model <- function(train_sf, test_sf, response, predictors, ntree = 500) {
  train_df <- train_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()
  test_df  <- test_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()

  tuning <- tune_rf_oob(train_df, response, predictors, ntree = ntree)

  rf_fit <- randomForest(
    x = train_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)),
    y = train_df[[response]],
    ntree = ntree,
    mtry = tuning$best_mtry,
    importance = TRUE
  )

  preds <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)))
  mets <- calc_metrics(test_df[[response]], preds)

  list(
    model = rf_fit,
    predictions = tibble(obs = test_df[[response]], pred = preds),
    metrics = mets,
    best_mtry = tuning$best_mtry,
    tuning_table = tuning$tuning_table
  )
}

run_ok_model <- function(train_sf, test_sf, response, cutoff, width) {
  train_sp <- as(train_sf, "Spatial")
  test_sp <- as(test_sf, "Spatial")

  f <- as.formula(paste(response, "~ 1"))
  vg <- variogram(f, data = train_sp, cutoff = cutoff, width = width)
  fit <- fit_variogram_models(vg)

  if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)

  kr <- krige(f, locations = train_sp, newdata = test_sp, model = fit)
  pred <- kr$var1.pred

  obs <- test_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% pull(.data[[response]])
  mets <- calc_metrics(obs, pred)

  list(
    variogram = vg,
    fit = fit,
    predictions = tibble(obs = obs, pred = pred),
    metrics = mets
  )
}
run_rk_model <- function(train_sf, test_sf, response, predictors, cutoff, width, ntree = 500) {
  train_df <- train_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()
  test_df  <- test_sf %>% st_drop_geometry() %>% select(all_of(c(response, predictors))) %>% na.omit()

  # keep matched sf rows
  train_sf2 <- train_sf %>% filter(complete.cases(st_drop_geometry(select(., all_of(c(response, predictors))))))
  test_sf2  <- test_sf %>% filter(complete.cases(st_drop_geometry(select(., all_of(c(response, predictors))))))

  tuning <- tune_rf_oob(train_df, response, predictors, ntree = ntree)

  rf_fit <- randomForest(
    x = train_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)),
    y = train_df[[response]],
    ntree = ntree,
    mtry = tuning$best_mtry,
    importance = TRUE
  )

  trend_train <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = train_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)))
  trend_test  <- predict(rf_fit, newdata = test_df %>% select(all_of(predictors)))

  train_sf2$residual <- train_df[[response]] - trend_train

  train_sp <- as(train_sf2, "Spatial")
  test_sp <- as(test_sf2, "Spatial")

  vg_resid <- variogram(residual ~ 1, data = train_sp, cutoff = cutoff, width = width)
  fit_resid <- fit_variogram_models(vg_resid)

  if (is.null(fit_resid)) {
    # fallback to trend-only
    pred <- trend_test
    obs <- test_df[[response]]

    return(list(
      rf_model = rf_fit,
      residual_variogram = vg_resid,
      residual_fit = NULL,
      predictions = tibble(obs = obs, pred = pred),
      metrics = calc_metrics(obs, pred),
      best_mtry = tuning$best_mtry,
      used_residual_kriging = FALSE
    ))
  }

  kr_resid <- krige(residual ~ 1, locations = train_sp, newdata = test_sp, model = fit_resid)
  pred <- trend_test + kr_resid$var1.pred
  obs <- test_df[[response]]

  list(
    rf_model = rf_fit,
    residual_variogram = vg_resid,
    residual_fit = fit_resid,
    predictions = tibble(obs = obs, pred = pred),
    metrics = calc_metrics(obs, pred),
    best_mtry = tuning$best_mtry,
    used_residual_kriging = TRUE
  )
}


run_one_iteration <- function(sf_data, split, response, predictors, dataset_name, cutoff, width, ntree = 500) {
  train_sf <- sf_data[split$train_ids, ]
  test_sf  <- sf_data[split$test_ids, ]

  rf_res <- run_rf_model(train_sf, test_sf, response, predictors, ntree = ntree)
  ok_res <- run_ok_model(train_sf, test_sf, response, cutoff = cutoff, width = width)
  rk_res <- run_rk_model(train_sf, test_sf, response, predictors, cutoff = cutoff, width = width, ntree = ntree)

  bind_rows(
    rf_res$metrics %>%
      mutate(
        dataset = dataset_name,
        variable = response,
        method = "RF",
        iteration = split$iteration,
        seed = split$seed,
        best_mtry = rf_res$best_mtry
      ),

    if (!is.null(ok_res)) {
      ok_res$metrics %>%
        mutate(
          dataset = dataset_name,
          variable = response,
          method = "OK",
          iteration = split$iteration,
          seed = split$seed,
          best_mtry = NA_real_
        )
    },

    rk_res$metrics %>%
      mutate(
        dataset = dataset_name,
        variable = response,
        method = "RK",
        iteration = split$iteration,
        seed = split$seed,
        best_mtry = rk_res$best_mtry,
        used_residual_kriging = rk_res$used_residual_kriging
      )
  )
}
```

```{r ensemble, warning=FALSE}
#ensemble mapping:
select_best_iterations <- function(results_tbl, top_frac = 0.25, n_fallback = 5) {
  
  results_tbl %>%
    filter(is.finite(RMSE), is.finite(R2)) %>%
    group_by(dataset, variable, method) %>%
    mutate(
      r2_cut   = quantile(R2, probs = 1 - top_frac, na.rm = TRUE),
      rmse_cut = quantile(RMSE, probs = top_frac, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      keep = R2 >= r2_cut & RMSE <= rmse_cut
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      rmse_score = ifelse(
        max(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE) == min(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE),
        1,
        (max(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE) - RMSE) /
          (max(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE) - min(RMSE, na.rm = TRUE))
      ),
      r2_score = ifelse(
        max(R2, na.rm = TRUE) == min(R2, na.rm = TRUE),
        1,
        (R2 - min(R2, na.rm = TRUE)) /
          (max(R2, na.rm = TRUE) - min(R2, na.rm = TRUE))
      ),
      score = 0.5 * rmse_score + 0.5 * r2_score
    ) %>%
    arrange(dataset, variable, method, desc(score)) %>%
    group_by(dataset, variable, method) %>%
    mutate(
      keep = ifelse(sum(keep, na.rm = TRUE) == 0 & row_number() <= n_fallback, TRUE, keep)
    ) %>%
    filter(keep) %>%
    mutate(
      weight = score / sum(score, na.rm = TRUE)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
}

selected_iters <- select_best_iterations(results_all, top_frac = 0.25, n_fallback = 5)

get_dataset_objects <- function(dataset_name) {
  if (dataset_name == "SP") {
    list(
      sf_data = soil_SP_cov,
      resamples = resamples_SP,
      cutoff = cutoff_SP,
      width = width_SP
    )
  } else if (dataset_name == "COMP") {
    list(
      sf_data = soil_COMP_cov,
      resamples = resamples_COMP,
      cutoff = cutoff_COMP,
      width = width_COMP
    )
  } else {
    stop("dataset_name must be 'SP' or 'COMP'")
  }
}

covariates_use <- cov_names
template_rast <- covariate_stack[[1]]

weighted_sd_rasters <- function(rast_stack, weights) {
  w <- weights / sum(weights)
  mu <- sum(rast_stack * w)
  var_r <- sum(((rast_stack - mu)^2) * w)
  sqrt(var_r)
}

build_one_prediction <- function(dataset_name, method_name, variable_name, iter_row,
                                 covariates_use, covariate_stack) {
  
  objs <- get_dataset_objects(dataset_name)
  sf_data <- objs$sf_data
  resamples <- objs$resamples
  cutoff <- objs$cutoff
  width <- objs$width
  
  split <- resamples[[iter_row$iteration]]
  train_sf <- sf_data[split$train_ids, ]
  
  # keep only complete cases for the modeled variable + predictors
  train_df <- train_sf %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    select(all_of(c(variable_name, covariates_use))) %>%
    na.omit()
  
  if (nrow(train_df) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  train_sf2 <- train_sf %>%
    filter(complete.cases(st_drop_geometry(select(., all_of(c(variable_name, covariates_use))))))
  
  if (nrow(train_sf2) < 5) return(NULL)
  
  # RF
  if (method_name == "RF") {
    set.seed(iter_row$seed)
    
    mtry_use <- iter_row$best_mtry
    if (!is.finite(mtry_use)) {
      mtry_use <- max(1, floor(sqrt(length(covariates_use))))
    }
    
    rf_model <- randomForest(
      x = train_df[, covariates_use, drop = FALSE],
      y = train_df[[variable_name]],
      ntree = 500,
      mtry = mtry_use,
      importance = TRUE
    )
    
    r_pred <- terra::predict(
      covariate_stack[[covariates_use]],
      rf_model,
      fun = function(model, data) {
        data <- as.data.frame(data)
        predict(model, newdata = data)
      },
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    return(r_pred)
  }
  
  # OK
  if (method_name == "OK") {
    vals <- train_sf2[[variable_name]]
    if (length(unique(vals)) <= 1) return(NULL)
    
    train_sp <- as(train_sf2, "Spatial")
    f <- as.formula(paste(variable_name, "~ 1"))
    
    vg <- tryCatch(
      variogram(f, data = train_sp, cutoff = cutoff, width = width),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(vg)) return(NULL)
    
    fit <- fit_variogram_models(vg)
    if (is.null(fit)) return(NULL)
    
    grid_pts <- terra::as.points(template_rast, values = FALSE)
    grid_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(grid_pts)
    
    ok_pred <- tryCatch(
      krige(f, train_sp, as(grid_sf, "Spatial"), model = fit),
      error = function(e) NULL
    )
    if (is.null(ok_pred)) return(NULL)
    
    pred_vect <- terra::vect(ok_pred)
    r_pred <- terra::rasterize(pred_vect, template_rast, field = "var1.pred")
    return(r_pred)
  }
  
  # RK = RF trend + kriged residuals
  if (method_name == "RK") {
    set.seed(iter_row$seed)
    
    mtry_use <- iter_row$best_mtry
    if (!is.finite(mtry_use)) {
      mtry_use <- max(1, floor(sqrt(length(covariates_use))))
    }
    
    rf_model <- randomForest(
      x = train_df[, covariates_use, drop = FALSE],
      y = train_df[[variable_name]],
      ntree = 500,
      mtry = mtry_use,
      importance = TRUE
    )
    
    trend_train <- predict(rf_model, newdata = train_df[, covariates_use, drop = FALSE])
    residuals_train <- train_df[[variable_name]] - trend_train
    
    trend_rast <- terra::predict(
      covariate_stack[[covariates_use]],
      rf_model,
      fun = function(model, data) {
        data <- as.data.frame(data)
        predict(model, newdata = data)
      },
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    
    if (isTRUE(iter_row$used_residual_kriging)) {
      train_res_sf <- train_sf2 %>% mutate(residual = residuals_train)
      train_res_sp <- as(train_res_sf, "Spatial")
      
      vg_resid <- tryCatch(
        variogram(residual ~ 1, data = train_res_sp, cutoff = cutoff, width = width),
        error = function(e) NULL
      )
      
      if (!is.null(vg_resid)) {
        fit_resid <- fit_variogram_models(vg_resid)
        
        if (!is.null(fit_resid)) {
          grid_pts <- terra::as.points(template_rast, values = FALSE)
          grid_sf <- sf::st_as_sf(grid_pts)
          
          rk_resid <- tryCatch(
            krige(residual ~ 1, train_res_sp, as(grid_sf, "Spatial"), model = fit_resid),
            error = function(e) NULL
          )
          
          if (!is.null(rk_resid)) {
            resid_vect <- terra::vect(rk_resid)
            resid_rast <- terra::rasterize(resid_vect, template_rast, field = "var1.pred")
            return(trend_rast + resid_rast)
          }
        }
      }
    }
    
    # fallback: trend-only
    return(trend_rast)
  }
  
  NULL
}

build_final_method_ensemble <- function(dataset_name, method_name, variable_name,
                                        selected_iters, covariates_use, covariate_stack) {
  
  sel <- selected_iters %>%
    filter(
      dataset == dataset_name,
      method == method_name,
      variable == variable_name
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(weight))
  
  if (nrow(sel) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  member_rasters <- list()
  member_weights <- c()
  member_meta <- list()
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(sel))) {
    r_pred <- build_one_prediction(
      dataset_name = dataset_name,
      method_name = method_name,
      variable_name = variable_name,
      iter_row = sel[i, ],
      covariates_use = covariates_use,
      covariate_stack = covariate_stack
    )
    
    if (!is.null(r_pred)) {
      member_rasters[[length(member_rasters) + 1]] <- r_pred
      member_weights <- c(member_weights, sel$weight[i])
      member_meta[[length(member_meta) + 1]] <- sel[i, ]
    }
  }
  
  if (length(member_rasters) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  rast_stack <- rast(member_rasters)
  member_weights <- member_weights / sum(member_weights)
  
  ens_mean <- sum(rast_stack * member_weights)
  ens_sd <- weighted_sd_rasters(rast_stack, member_weights)
  
  names(ens_mean) <- paste(dataset_name, method_name, variable_name, "ensemble_mean", sep = "_")
  names(ens_sd)   <- paste(dataset_name, method_name, variable_name, "ensemble_sd", sep = "_")
  
  list(
    mean = ens_mean,
    sd = ens_sd,
    members = rast_stack,
    weights = member_weights,
    selected_rows = bind_rows(member_meta)
  )
}

final_ensemble_rasters <- list()

for (ds in c("SP", "COMP")) {
  final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]] <- list()
  
  for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
    final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]] <- list()
    
    for (v in soil_vars) {
      cat("Building final ensemble:", ds, meth, v, "\n")
      
      final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]][[v]] <- build_final_method_ensemble(
        dataset_name = ds,
        method_name = meth,
        variable_name = v,
        selected_iters = selected_iters,
        covariates_use = covariates_use,
        covariate_stack = covariate_stack
      )
    }
  }
}

par(mfrow = c(3, 3))

for (ds in names(final_ensemble_rasters)) {
  for (meth in names(final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]])) {
    for (v in names(final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]])) {
```

```{r comparison}

#not ensemble: original repeated resampling results in results_all:
    # one row per iteration × dataset × nutrient × method
    # metric computed on the held-out test set for that iteration
    # 
    # Then the p-tests compare those per-iteration metrics in a paired way.


compare_methods_paired <- function(results_tbl, metric = "RMSE") {
  
  method_pairs <- list(
    c("RF", "OK"),
    c("RK", "RF"),
    c("RK", "OK")
  )
  
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (ds in unique(results_tbl$dataset)) {
    for (v in unique(results_tbl$variable)) {
      
      sub <- results_tbl %>%
        filter(dataset == ds, variable == v) %>%
        select(iteration, method, all_of(metric)) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = all_of(metric))
      
      for (pair in method_pairs) {
        m1 <- pair[1]
        m2 <- pair[2]
        
        if (all(c(m1, m2) %in% names(sub))) {
          dat <- sub %>%
            select(iteration, all_of(c(m1, m2))) %>%
            drop_na()
          
          if (nrow(dat) >= 3) {
            test <- wilcox.test(dat[[m1]], dat[[m2]], paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
            
            out[[k]] <- tibble(
              dataset = ds,
              variable = v,
              comparison = paste0(m1, "_vs_", m2),
              metric = metric,
              n_pairs = nrow(dat),
              median_diff = median(dat[[m1]] - dat[[m2]], na.rm = TRUE),
              p_value = test$p.value
            )
            k <- k + 1
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out)
}

rmse_tests <- compare_methods_paired(results_all, metric = "RMSE")
mae_tests  <- compare_methods_paired(results_all, metric = "MAE")
r2_tests   <- compare_methods_paired(results_all, metric = "R2")

method_p_tests <- bind_rows(rmse_tests, mae_tests, r2_tests)
method_p_tests <- method_p_tests %>%
  group_by(metric) %>%
  mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
  ungroup()

compare_sampling_paired <- function(results_tbl, metric = "RMSE") {
  
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (m in unique(results_tbl$method)) {
    for (v in unique(results_tbl$variable)) {
      
      sub <- results_tbl %>%
        filter(method == m, variable == v) %>%
        select(iteration, dataset, all_of(metric)) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = all_of(metric))
      
      if (all(c("SP", "COMP") %in% names(sub))) {
        dat <- sub %>%
          select(iteration, SP, COMP) %>%
          drop_na()
        
        if (nrow(dat) >= 3) {
          test <- wilcox.test(dat$SP, dat$COMP, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
          
          out[[k]] <- tibble(
            method = m,
            variable = v,
            metric = metric,
            n_pairs = nrow(dat),
            median_diff = median(dat$SP - dat$COMP, na.rm = TRUE),
            p_value = test$p.value
          )
          k <- k + 1
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out)
}

spcomp_rmse_tests <- compare_sampling_paired(results_all, metric = "RMSE")
spcomp_mae_tests  <- compare_sampling_paired(results_all, metric = "MAE")
spcomp_r2_tests   <- compare_sampling_paired(results_all, metric = "R2")
```

```{r differences}
  vals <- terra::values(r, na.rm = TRUE)
  vals <- vals[is.finite(vals)]
  
  tibble(
    mean = mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    median = median(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd = sd(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    min = min(vals, na.rm = TRUE),
    max = max(vals, na.rm = TRUE),

map_correlation <- function(r1, r2) {
  vals <- cbind(terra::values(r1), terra::values(r2))
  vals <- vals[complete.cases(vals), , drop = FALSE]
  
  tibble(
    pearson_r = cor(vals[,1], vals[,2], method = "pearson"),
    spearman_r = cor(vals[,1], vals[,2], method = "spearman")
  )
}

plot_diff_maps <- function(diff_tbl, title_cols) {
  n_maps <- nrow(diff_tbl)
  ncol_plot <- 3
  nrow_plot <- ceiling(n_maps / ncol_plot)
  
  op <- par(mfrow = c(nrow_plot, ncol_plot))
  
  for (i in seq_len(n_maps)) {
    ttl <- paste(diff_tbl[i, title_cols] %>% as.character(), collapse = " | ")
    plot(diff_tbl$raster[[i]], main = ttl)
  }
  
  par(op)
}

plot_diff_maps_chunked <- function(diff_tbl, title_cols, n_per_page = 9, ncol_plot = 3) {

  for (ii in idx) {
    sub_tbl <- diff_tbl[ii, ]
    n_maps <- nrow(sub_tbl)
    nrow_plot <- ceiling(n_maps / ncol_plot)
    
    op <- par(mfrow = c(nrow_plot, ncol_plot), mar = c(3, 3, 2, 1))
    
    for (i in seq_len(n_maps)) {
      ttl <- paste(sub_tbl[i, title_cols] %>% as.character(), collapse = " | ")
      plot(sub_tbl$raster[[i]], main = ttl)

    par(op)
```

```{r ensemble validation}
ap_val <- read_csv("../LOCAL DATA DO NOT PUSH/Ap_hz_data/hz_0_15_wide_03_30_2026.csv")

val_var_lookup <- c(
  "ca" = "Ca_0_15",
  "k" = "K_0_15",
  "mg" = "Mg_0_15",
  "mn" = "Mn_0_15",
  "p" = "P_0_15",
  "zn" = "Zn_0_15",

  "lbc_1" = "LBC.1_0_15",
  "lb_ceq" = "LBCeq_0_15"

extract_continuous_validation <- function(ap_val_sf, final_ensemble_rasters, val_var_lookup) {
  out_list <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (ds in c("SP", "COMP")) {
    for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
      for (nm in names(val_var_lookup)) {
        
        obj <- final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]][[nm]]
        if (is.null(obj) || is.null(obj$mean)) next
        
        pred_rast <- obj$mean
        obs_col <- val_var_lookup[[nm]]
        
        ext <- terra::extract(pred_rast, terra::vect(ap_val_sf))
        
        tmp <- ap_val_sf %>%
          st_drop_geometry() %>%
          transmute(
            Point = Point,
            dataset = ds,
            method = meth,
            nutrient = nm,
            observed = .data[[obs_col]],
            predicted = ext[, 2]
          ) %>%
          filter(!is.na(observed), !is.na(predicted))
        
        out_list[[k]] <- tmp
        k <- k + 1
      }
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out_list)
}

continuous_val_tbl <- extract_continuous_validation(ap_val_sf, final_ensemble_rasters, val_var_lookup)
continuous_val_tbl

calc_validation_metrics <- function(obs, pred) {
  tibble(
    n = length(obs),
    RMSE = sqrt(mean((obs - pred)^2, na.rm = TRUE)),
    MAE = mean(abs(obs - pred), na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_error = mean(obs - pred, na.rm = TRUE),
    R2 = ifelse(length(unique(obs)) > 1, cor(obs, pred, use = "complete.obs")^2, NA_real_),
    spearman_rho = ifelse(length(unique(obs)) > 1, cor(obs, pred, method = "spearman", use = "complete.obs"), NA_real_)
  )
}

continuous_val_metrics <- continuous_val_tbl %>%
  group_by(dataset, method, nutrient) %>%
  group_modify(~ calc_validation_metrics(.x$observed, .x$predicted)) %>%
  ungroup()

continuous_val_metrics

continuous_val_ranked2 <- continuous_val_metrics %>%
  group_by(nutrient) %>%
  mutate(
    rmse_score = ifelse(max(RMSE) == min(RMSE), 1,
                        (max(RMSE) - RMSE) / (max(RMSE) - min(RMSE))),
    r2_score = ifelse(max(R2, na.rm = TRUE) == min(R2, na.rm = TRUE), 1,
                      (R2 - min(R2, na.rm = TRUE)) / (max(R2, na.rm = TRUE) - min(R2, na.rm = TRUE))),
    overall_score = 0.5 * rmse_score + 0.5 * r2_score
  ) %>%
  arrange(nutrient, desc(overall_score)) %>%
  ungroup()

plot_continuous_validation_clean <- function(continuous_val_tbl, nutrient_name,
                                             outlier_thresh = 3) {
  
  dat0 <- continuous_val_tbl %>%
    filter(nutrient == nutrient_name) %>%
    filter(is.finite(observed), is.finite(predicted))
  
  # fit within each panel, remove extreme outliers by studentized residual
  dat_clean <- dat0 %>%
    group_by(dataset, method) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      df <- .x
      
      if (nrow(df) < 4 || length(unique(df$observed)) < 2) {
        df$stud_resid <- NA_real_
        df$keep <- TRUE
        return(df)
      }
      
      fit <- lm(predicted ~ observed, data = df)
      df$stud_resid <- rstudent(fit)
      df$keep <- abs(df$stud_resid) <= outlier_thresh | is.na(df$stud_resid)
      df
    }) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    filter(keep)
  
  # panel-wise stats after outlier removal
  panel_stats <- dat_clean %>%
    group_by(dataset, method) %>%
    group_modify(~{
      df <- .x
      
      if (nrow(df) < 3 || length(unique(df$observed)) < 2) {
        return(tibble(
          n = nrow(df),
          r2 = NA_real_,
          slope = NA_real_,
          intercept = NA_real_,
          x = NA_real_,
          y = NA_real_,
          lab = paste0("n = ", nrow(df), "\nR² = NA")
        ))
      }
      
      fit <- lm(predicted ~ observed, data = df)
      s <- summary(fit)
      cf <- coef(fit)
      
      x_pos <- min(df$observed, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05 * diff(range(df$observed, na.rm = TRUE))
      y_pos <- max(df$predicted, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.08 * diff(range(df$predicted, na.rm = TRUE))
      
      tibble(
        n = nrow(df),
        r2 = s$r.squared,
        slope = unname(cf[2]),
        intercept = unname(cf[1]),
        x = x_pos,
        y = y_pos,
        lab = paste0(
          "n = ", nrow(df),
          "\nR² = ", round(s$r.squared, 2),
          "\ny = ", round(cf[1], 2), " + ", round(cf[2], 2), "x"
        )
      )
    }) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  plot_continuous_validation_clean <- function(continuous_val_tbl, nutrient_name, iqr_mult = 1.5) {
  
  dat0 <- continuous_val_tbl %>%
    dplyr::filter(nutrient == nutrient_name) %>%
    dplyr::filter(is.finite(observed), is.finite(predicted))
  
  # remove extreme outliers relative to the 1:1 line within each panel
  dat_clean <- dat0 %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dataset, method) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(~{
      df <- .x
      df$resid_11 <- df$predicted - df$observed
      
      q1 <- quantile(df$resid_11, 0.25, na.rm = TRUE)
      q3 <- quantile(df$resid_11, 0.75, na.rm = TRUE)
      iqr <- q3 - q1
      
      lower <- q1 - iqr_mult * iqr
      upper <- q3 + iqr_mult * iqr
      
      df %>%
        dplyr::filter(resid_11 >= lower, resid_11 <= upper)
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  # panel stats after outlier removal
  panel_stats <- dat_clean %>%
    dplyr::group_by(dataset, method) %>%
    dplyr::group_modify(~{
      df <- .x
      
      if (nrow(df) < 3 || dplyr::n_distinct(df$observed) < 2) {
        return(tibble::tibble(
          n = nrow(df),
          r2 = NA_real_,
          x = NA_real_,
          y = NA_real_,
          lab = paste0("n = ", nrow(df), "\nR² = NA")
        ))
      }
      
      fit <- lm(predicted ~ observed, data = df)
      r2 <- summary(fit)$r.squared
      
      x_pos <- min(df$observed, na.rm = TRUE) + 0.05 * diff(range(df$observed, na.rm = TRUE))
      y_pos <- max(df$predicted, na.rm = TRUE) - 0.08 * diff(range(df$predicted, na.rm = TRUE))
      
      tibble::tibble(
        n = nrow(df),
        r2 = r2,
        x = x_pos,
        y = y_pos,
        lab = paste0("n = ", nrow(df), "\nR² = ", round(r2, 2))
      )
    }) %>%
    dplyr::ungroup()
  
  ggplot2::ggplot(dat_clean, ggplot2::aes(x = observed, y = predicted)) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.7) +
    ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
    ggplot2::geom_text(
      data = panel_stats,
      ggplot2::aes(x = x, y = y, label = lab),
      inherit.aes = FALSE,
      hjust = 0,
      vjust = 1,
      size = 3
    ) +
    ggplot2::facet_grid(dataset ~ method, scales = "free") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = paste("Validation:", nutrient_name),
      subtitle = paste("Extreme outliers removed using 1:1 residual IQR filter (", iqr_mult, "× IQR)", sep = ""),
      x = "Observed (validation 0–15 cm)",
      y = "Predicted (ensemble mean)"
    )
  }

compare_sampling_abs_resid <- function(resid_tbl) {
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (meth in unique(resid_tbl$method)) {
    for (nut in unique(resid_tbl$nutrient)) {
      sub <- resid_tbl %>%
        filter(method == meth, nutrient == nut) %>%
        select(Point, dataset, abs_residual) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = dataset, values_from = abs_residual)
      
      if (all(c("SP", "COMP") %in% names(sub))) {
        dat <- sub %>% drop_na()
        if (nrow(dat) >= 5) {
          test <- wilcox.test(dat$SP, dat$COMP, paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
          
          out[[k]] <- tibble(
            method = meth,
            nutrient = nut,
            n_pairs = nrow(dat),
            median_diff = median(dat$SP - dat$COMP, na.rm = TRUE),
            p_value = test$p.value
          )
          k <- k + 1
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out) %>%
    group_by(nutrient) %>%
    mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    ungroup()
}

continuous_spcomp_tests <- compare_sampling_abs_resid(continuous_val_residuals)
continuous_spcomp_tests

compare_methods_abs_resid <- function(resid_tbl) {
  method_pairs <- list(
    c("RF", "OK"),
    c("RK", "RF"),
    c("RK", "OK")
  )
  
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (ds in unique(resid_tbl$dataset)) {
    for (nut in unique(resid_tbl$nutrient)) {
      sub <- resid_tbl %>%
        filter(dataset == ds, nutrient == nut) %>%
        select(Point, method, abs_residual) %>%
        pivot_wider(names_from = method, values_from = abs_residual)
      
      for (pair in method_pairs) {
        m1 <- pair[1]
        m2 <- pair[2]
        
        if (all(c(m1, m2) %in% names(sub))) {
          dat <- sub %>% select(Point, all_of(c(m1, m2))) %>% drop_na()
          
          if (nrow(dat) >= 5) {
            test <- wilcox.test(dat[[m1]], dat[[m2]], paired = TRUE, exact = FALSE)
            
            out[[k]] <- tibble(
              dataset = ds,
              nutrient = nut,
              comparison = paste0(m1, "_vs_", m2),
              n_pairs = nrow(dat),
              median_diff = median(dat[[m1]] - dat[[m2]], na.rm = TRUE),
              p_value = test$p.value
            )
            k <- k + 1
          }
        }
      }
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out) %>%
    group_by(nutrient) %>%
    mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    ungroup()
}
```

```{r variogram all}
make_variograms <- function(dat_sf, soil_vars, cutoff, width) {
  dat_sp <- as(dat_sf, "Spatial")
  
  out <- purrr::map(soil_vars, function(v) {
    f <- as.formula(paste(v, "~ 1"))
    gstat::variogram(f, data = dat_sp, cutoff = cutoff, width = width)
  })
  
  names(out) <- soil_vars
  out
}

fit_variogram_models <- function(vg) {
  vg_df <- as.data.frame(vg)
  
  init_nugget <- max(0, min(vg_df$gamma, na.rm = TRUE) * 0.5)
  init_sill   <- max(vg_df$gamma, na.rm = TRUE)
  init_psill  <- max(init_sill - init_nugget, 1e-6)
  init_range  <- max(vg_df$dist, na.rm = TRUE) / 3
  
  candidate_models <- c("Sph", "Exp")
  
  fits <- purrr::map(candidate_models, function(m) {
    tryCatch({
      fit <- fit.variogram(
        vg,
        model = vgm(
          psill = init_psill,
          model = m,
          range = init_range,
          nugget = init_nugget
        )
      )
      
      if (any(!is.finite(fit$psill))) return(NULL)
      if (any(!is.finite(fit$range))) return(NULL)
      if (any(fit$range[fit$model != "Nug"] <= 0)) return(NULL)
      
      fit
    }, error = function(e) NULL)
  })
  
  fits <- fits[!sapply(fits, is.null)]
  if (length(fits) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  sse <- sapply(fits, function(f) attr(f, "SSErr"))
  fits[[which.min(sse)]]
}

fit_spval <- purrr::map(vg_spval, fit_variogram_models)
fit_compval <- purrr::map(vg_compval, fit_variogram_models)

plot_vg_with_fit <- function(vg, fit = NULL, title = "") {
  vg_df <- as.data.frame(vg)
  
  plot(
    vg_df$dist, vg_df$gamma,
    main = title,
    xlab = "Distance",
    ylab = "Semivariance",
    pch = 16
  )
  
  if (!is.null(fit)) {
    good_range <- all(is.finite(fit$range[fit$model != "Nug"])) &&
      all(fit$range[fit$model != "Nug"] > 0)
    
    good_psill <- all(is.finite(fit$psill)) &&
      sum(fit$psill, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
    
    if (good_range && good_psill) {
      vline <- variogramLine(fit, maxdist = max(vg_df$dist))
      lines(vline$dist, vline$gamma, col = "red", lwd = 2)
    }
  }
}

extract_vg_metrics <- function(fit, var_name, dataset) {
  if (is.null(fit)) {
    return(tibble(
      dataset = dataset,
      variable = var_name,
      model = NA_character_,
      nugget = NA_real_,
      sill = NA_real_,
      range = NA_real_,
      nugget_ratio = NA_real_,
      SSErr = NA_real_
    ))
  }
  
  nugget <- fit$psill[fit$model == "Nug"]
  if (length(nugget) == 0) nugget <- 0
  
  sill <- sum(fit$psill, na.rm = TRUE)
  range <- fit$range[fit$model != "Nug"][1]
  
  tibble(
    dataset = dataset,
    variable = var_name,
    model = fit$model[fit$model != "Nug"][1],
    nugget = nugget,
    sill = sill,
    range = range,
    nugget_ratio = nugget / sill,
    SSErr = attr(fit, "SSErr")
  )
}
```

```{r clustering}
zone_vars <- c("p_h_2", "ca", "k", "mg", "mn", "p", "zn")
context_vars <- c("lbc_1", "lb_ceq")   # summarize later, but do not cluster on them
all_zone_summary_vars <- c(zone_vars, context_vars)

build_method_stack_current <- function(final_ensemble_rasters, dataset_name, method_name, vars_use) {
  rast_list <- list()
  
  for (v in vars_use) {
    obj <- final_ensemble_rasters[[dataset_name]][[method_name]][[v]]
    
    if (is.null(obj)) {
      message("Dropping ", dataset_name, " ", method_name, " ", v, ": object is NULL")
      next
    }
    
    # allow either a list(mean = raster) or a bare raster
    if (inherits(obj, "SpatRaster")) {
      r <- obj
    } else if (is.list(obj) && !is.null(obj$mean) && inherits(obj$mean, "SpatRaster")) {
      r <- obj$mean
    } else {
      message("Dropping ", dataset_name, " ", method_name, " ", v,
              ": object exists but is not a usable raster/list(mean=raster)")
      next
    }
    
    vals <- terra::values(r, mat = FALSE)
    n_valid <- sum(!is.na(vals))
    
    if (n_valid > 0) {
      rast_list[[v]] <- r
    } else {
      message("Dropping ", dataset_name, " ", method_name, " ", v,
              " because it has 0 valid cells.")
    }
  }
  
  if (length(rast_list) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  out <- terra::rast(rast_list)
  names(out) <- names(rast_list)
  out
}

filter_stack_by_completeness <- function(r_stack, max_na_prop = 0.4) {
  keep <- sapply(names(r_stack), function(nm) {
    vals <- terra::values(r_stack[[nm]], mat = FALSE)
    mean(is.na(vals)) <= max_na_prop
  })
  
  r_stack[[names(r_stack)[keep]]]
}

mask_to_common_support <- function(r_stack) {
  valid_sum <- sum(!is.na(r_stack))
  common_mask <- valid_sum == terra::nlyr(r_stack)
  terra::mask(r_stack, common_mask, maskvalues = 0)
}

sample_raster_pixels <- function(r_stack, n = 10000, seed = 123) {
  set.seed(seed)
  
  samp <- terra::spatSample(
    r_stack,
    size = n,
    method = "random",
    na.rm = TRUE,
    as.df = TRUE,
    warn = FALSE
  )
  
  samp <- as.data.frame(samp)
  samp <- samp[, names(r_stack), drop = FALSE]
  samp <- samp[complete.cases(samp), , drop = FALSE]
  
  samp
}

fit_sample_kmeans_zones <- function(sample_df, k = 4, seed = 123) {
  sample_df <- as.data.frame(sample_df)
  
  if (nrow(sample_df) == 0) stop("No sampled pixels available after NA filtering.")
  
  sample_df <- sample_df[, vapply(sample_df, is.numeric, logical(1)), drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(sample_df) == 0) stop("No numeric raster layers available for clustering.")
  
  keep <- vapply(sample_df, function(x) {
    sx <- sd(x, na.rm = TRUE)
    is.finite(sx) && sx > 0
  }, logical(1))
  
  sample_df <- sample_df[, keep, drop = FALSE]
  if (ncol(sample_df) == 0) stop("All sampled raster layers had zero variance.")
  
  k_use <- min(k, nrow(sample_df))
  if (k_use < 2) stop("Too few sampled pixels to create 2 or more clusters.")
  
  x <- scale(sample_df)
  
  set.seed(seed)
  km <- kmeans(x, centers = k_use, nstart = 25)
  
  list(
    model = km,
    centers = km$centers,
    scale_center = attr(x, "scaled:center"),
    scale_scale  = attr(x, "scaled:scale"),
    kept_names = colnames(sample_df),
    sample_scaled = x,
    sample_cluster = km$cluster
  )
}

  sample_df <- as.data.frame(sample_df)
  
  if (nrow(sample_df) == 0) stop("No sampled pixels available after NA filtering.")
  
  sample_df <- sample_df[, vapply(sample_df, is.numeric, logical(1)), drop = FALSE]

  if (k_use < 2) stop("Too few sampled pixels to create 2 or more clusters.")
  
  x <- scale(sample_df)
  
  set.seed(seed)
  km <- kmeans(x, centers = k_use, nstart = 25)
  
  list(

  )
}

assign_raster_to_centroids <- function(r_stack, zone_fit, filename = NULL, overwrite = TRUE) {
  
  centers <- as.matrix(zone_fit$centers)
  scale_center <- zone_fit$scale_center
  scale_scale  <- zone_fit$scale_scale
  
  zone_fun <- function(v) {
    if (is.null(dim(v))) {
      v <- matrix(v, ncol = length(scale_center), byrow = TRUE)
    } else {
      v <- as.matrix(v)
    }
    
    out <- rep(NA_integer_, nrow(v))
    ok <- complete.cases(v)
    if (!any(ok)) return(out)
    
    x <- v[ok, , drop = FALSE]
    x_scaled <- sweep(x, 2, scale_center, "-")
    x_scaled <- sweep(x_scaled, 2, scale_scale, "/")
    
    dmat <- vapply(seq_len(nrow(centers)), function(j) {
      rowSums((x_scaled - matrix(
        centers[j, ],
        nrow = nrow(x_scaled),
        ncol = ncol(x_scaled),
        byrow = TRUE
      ))^2)
    }, FUN.VALUE = numeric(nrow(x_scaled)))
    
    dmat <- as.matrix(dmat)
    if (nrow(dmat) != nrow(x_scaled)) dmat <- t(dmat)
    
    out[ok] <- max.col(-dmat, ties.method = "first")
    out
  }
  
  if (is.null(filename)) {
    z <- terra::app(r_stack, fun = zone_fun)
  } else {
    z <- terra::app(
      r_stack,
      fun = zone_fun,
      filename = filename,
      overwrite = overwrite,
      wopt = list(datatype = "INT2S")
    )
  }
  
  names(z) <- "management_zone"
  z
}

management_zone_rasters <- list()

for (ds in c("SP", "COMP")) {
  management_zone_rasters[[ds]] <- list()
  
  for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
    cat("Creating zones for", ds, meth, "\n")
    
    management_zone_rasters[[ds]][[meth]] <- tryCatch({
      r_stack <- build_method_stack_current(
        final_ensemble_rasters = final_ensemble_rasters,
        dataset_name = ds,
        method_name = meth,
        vars_use = zone_vars
      )
      
      if (is.null(r_stack)) stop("No usable layers in stack.")
      
      r_stack <- filter_stack_by_completeness(r_stack, max_na_prop = 0.4)
      if (is.null(r_stack) || terra::nlyr(r_stack) < 2) {
        stop("Fewer than 2 usable layers after completeness filtering.")
      }
      
      r_stack <- mask_to_common_support(r_stack)
      
      samp <- sample_raster_pixels(r_stack, n = 10000, seed = 123)
      if (nrow(samp) < 10) stop("Too few complete sampled pixels after filtering.")
      
      fit <- fit_sample_kmeans_zones(samp, k = 4, seed = 123)
      r_stack_use <- r_stack[[fit$kept_names]]
      
      assign_raster_to_centroids(r_stack = r_stack_use, zone_fit = fit)
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      message("Failed for ", ds, " ", meth, ": ", e$message)
      NULL
    })
  }
}

summarize_clusters <- function(zone_raster, nutrient_stack) {
  zone_vals <- terra::values(zone_raster, mat = FALSE)
  nut_vals  <- terra::as.data.frame(nutrient_stack, na.rm = FALSE)
  
  vals <- dplyr::bind_cols(
    tibble::tibble(zone = zone_vals),
    nut_vals
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(zone)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_all(-1, ~ !is.na(.x)))
  
  nutrient_cols <- setdiff(names(vals), "zone")
  
  vals %>%
    dplyr::group_by(zone) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(
        .cols = dplyr::all_of(nutrient_cols),
        .fns = list(
          mean = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
          median = ~median(.x, na.rm = TRUE),
          sd = ~sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
        ),
        .names = "{.col}_{.fn}"
      ),
      n_cells = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(zone)
}

cluster_profile_zscores <- function(zone_raster, nutrient_stack) {
  zone_vals <- terra::values(zone_raster, mat = FALSE)
  nut_vals  <- terra::as.data.frame(nutrient_stack, na.rm = FALSE)
  
  vals <- dplyr::bind_cols(
    tibble::tibble(zone = zone_vals),
    nut_vals
  ) %>%
    dplyr::filter(!is.na(zone)) %>%
    dplyr::filter(dplyr::if_all(-1, ~ !is.na(.x)))
  
  nutrient_cols <- setdiff(names(vals), "zone")
  
  vals_z <- vals
  vals_z[nutrient_cols] <- lapply(vals_z[nutrient_cols], function(x) as.numeric(scale(x)))
  
  vals_z %>%
    dplyr::group_by(zone) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(
      dplyr::across(
        .cols = dplyr::all_of(nutrient_cols),
        .fns = ~mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
      ),
      n_cells = dplyr::n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    dplyr::arrange(zone)
}

cluster_summary_list <- list()
cluster_profile_list <- list()

for (ds in c("SP", "COMP")) {
  for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
    cat("Summarizing clusters for", ds, meth, "\n")
    
    z <- management_zone_rasters[[ds]][[meth]]
    if (is.null(z)) next
    
    stack_i <- build_method_stack_current(
      final_ensemble_rasters = final_ensemble_rasters,
      dataset_name = ds,
      method_name = meth,
      vars_use = all_zone_summary_vars
    )
    if (is.null(stack_i)) next
    
    stack_i <- filter_stack_by_completeness(stack_i, max_na_prop = 0.4)
    stack_i <- mask_to_common_support(stack_i)
    
    cl_sum <- summarize_clusters(z, stack_i) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(dataset = ds, method = meth) %>%
      dplyr::relocate(dataset, method)
    
    cl_prof <- cluster_profile_zscores(z, stack_i) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(dataset = ds, method = meth) %>%
      dplyr::relocate(dataset, method)
    
    cluster_summary_list[[paste(ds, meth, sep = "_")]] <- cl_sum
    cluster_profile_list[[paste(ds, meth, sep = "_")]] <- cl_prof
  }
}

    fertility_score = mean(c_across(all_of(priority_vars)), na.rm = TRUE)
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup() %>%
  dplyr::group_by(dataset, method) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(fertility_score, .by_group = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    new_zone = dplyr::row_number(),
    n_zones_map = dplyr::n(),
    priority_label = dplyr::case_when(
      n_zones_map == 2 & new_zone == 1 ~ "High priority",
      n_zones_map == 2 & new_zone == 2 ~ "Low priority",
      
      n_zones_map == 3 & new_zone == 1 ~ "High priority",
      n_zones_map == 3 & new_zone == 2 ~ "Moderate priority",
      n_zones_map == 3 & new_zone == 3 ~ "Low priority",
      
      n_zones_map == 4 & new_zone == 1 ~ "High priority",
      n_zones_map == 4 & new_zone == 2 ~ "Moderate-high priority",
      n_zones_map == 4 & new_zone == 3 ~ "Moderate-low priority",
      n_zones_map == 4 & new_zone == 4 ~ "Low priority",
      
      TRUE ~ paste("Zone", new_zone)
    )
  ) %>%
  dplyr::ungroup()

relabel_zone_raster <- function(zone_raster, lookup_df, ds, meth) {
  lut <- lookup_df %>%
    dplyr::filter(dataset == ds, method == meth) %>%
    dplyr::select(zone, new_zone, priority_label)
  
  if (nrow(lut) == 0) return(NULL)
  
  vals <- terra::values(zone_raster, mat = FALSE)
  new_vals <- vals
  
  for (i in seq_len(nrow(lut))) {
    new_vals[vals == lut$zone[i]] <- lut$new_zone[i]
  }
  
  out <- zone_raster
  terra::values(out) <- new_vals
  names(out) <- paste0(ds, "_", meth, "_priority_zone")
  
  out <- terra::as.factor(out)
  lv <- data.frame(
    value = lut$new_zone,
    label = lut$priority_label
  )
  levels(out) <- lv
  
  out
}
```

```{r zonal stats}
extract_zone_pairs <- function(r1, r2, name1 = "zone1", name2 = "zone2") {
  v1 <- terra::values(r1, mat = FALSE)
  v2 <- terra::values(r2, mat = FALSE)
  
  out <- tibble(
    !!name1 := v1,
    !!name2 := v2
  ) %>%
    filter(!is.na(.data[[name1]]), !is.na(.data[[name2]]))
  
  out
}

zone_agreement_metrics <- function(pair_df, z1 = "zone1", z2 = "zone2") {
  tab <- table(pair_df[[z1]], pair_df[[z2]])
  
  overall_agreement <- sum(diag(tab)) / sum(tab)
  
  # simple Cohen's kappa by hand
  row_marg <- rowSums(tab)
  col_marg <- colSums(tab)
  expected <- sum(row_marg * col_marg) / (sum(tab)^2)
  kappa <- (overall_agreement - expected) / (1 - expected)
  
  tibble(
    n_cells = sum(tab),
    overall_agreement = overall_agreement,
    kappa = kappa
  )
}



zone_weighted_kappa <- function(pair_df, z1 = "zone1", z2 = "zone2") {
  dat <- pair_df %>%
    transmute(
      z1 = as.integer(.data[[z1]]),
      z2 = as.integer(.data[[z2]])
    )
  
  kk_equal <- irr::kappa2(dat, weight = "equal")
  
  tibble(
    weighted_kappa = kk_equal$value
  )
}

compare_sp_comp_zones <- function(relabeled_management_zone_rasters) {
  out_metrics <- list()
  out_tabs <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
    z_sp <- relabeled_management_zone_rasters[["SP"]][[meth]]
    z_comp <- relabeled_management_zone_rasters[["COMP"]][[meth]]
    
    if (is.null(z_sp) || is.null(z_comp)) next
    
    pairs <- extract_zone_pairs(z_sp, z_comp, "SP_zone", "COMP_zone")
    mets <- zone_agreement_metrics(pairs, "SP_zone", "COMP_zone")
    wk <- zone_weighted_kappa(pairs, "SP_zone", "COMP_zone")
    
    out_metrics[[k]] <- bind_cols(
      tibble(comparison = "SP_vs_COMP", method = meth),
      mets,
      wk
    )
    
    out_tabs[[meth]] <- as.data.frame.matrix(table(pairs$SP_zone, pairs$COMP_zone))
    k <- k + 1
  }
  
  list(
    metrics = bind_rows(out_metrics),
    confusion_tables = out_tabs
  )
}

      k <- k + 1
    }
  }

    metrics = bind_rows(out_metrics),
    confusion_tables = out_tabs
  )

zone_near_agreement <- function(pair_df, z1 = "zone1", z2 = "zone2") {
  dz <- abs(as.integer(pair_df[[z1]]) - as.integer(pair_df[[z2]]))
  
  tibble(
    exact_agreement = mean(dz == 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    within_1_zone = mean(dz <= 1, na.rm = TRUE),
    mean_abs_zone_diff = mean(dz, na.rm = TRUE)
  )
}

plot_confusion_heatmap <- function(tab_df, title = "Zone confusion matrix") {
  tab_df %>%
    tibble::rownames_to_column("row_zone") %>%
    pivot_longer(-row_zone, names_to = "col_zone", values_to = "n") %>%
    ggplot(aes(x = col_zone, y = row_zone, fill = n)) +
    geom_tile() +
    geom_text(aes(label = n), color = "black") +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue") +
    theme_minimal() +
    labs(title = title, x = "Map 2 zone", y = "Map 1 zone")
}
```

```{r zonal validation}
extract_zone_validation <- function(ap_val_sf, relabeled_management_zone_rasters) {
  out_list <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (ds in c("SP", "COMP")) {
    for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
      z <- relabeled_management_zone_rasters[[ds]][[meth]]
      if (is.null(z)) next
      
      ext <- terra::extract(z, terra::vect(ap_val_sf))
      
      tmp <- ap_val_sf %>%
        st_drop_geometry() %>%
        mutate(
          dataset = ds,
          method = meth,
          zone = ext[, 2]
        )
      
      out_list[[k]] <- tmp
      k <- k + 1
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out_list)
}

summarize_validation_by_zone <- function(zone_val_tbl, val_var_lookup) {
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (nm in names(val_var_lookup)) {
    val_col <- val_var_lookup[[nm]]
    
    tmp <- zone_val_tbl %>%
      filter(!is.na(zone), !is.na(.data[[val_col]])) %>%
      group_by(dataset, method, zone) %>%
      summarise(
        nutrient = nm,
        n_points = n(),
        mean_val = mean(.data[[val_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        median_val = median(.data[[val_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        sd_val = sd(.data[[val_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      )
    
    out[[k]] <- tmp
    k <- k + 1
  }
  
  bind_rows(out)
}

kruskal_zone_validation <- function(zone_val_tbl, val_var_lookup) {
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (nm in names(val_var_lookup)) {
    val_col <- val_var_lookup[[nm]]
    
    for (ds in unique(zone_val_tbl$dataset)) {
      for (meth in unique(zone_val_tbl$method)) {
        
        dat <- zone_val_tbl %>%
          filter(dataset == ds, method == meth, !is.na(zone), !is.na(.data[[val_col]])) %>%
          mutate(zone = factor(zone))
        
        if (nrow(dat) < 5 || n_distinct(dat$zone) < 2) next
        
        test <- kruskal.test(dat[[val_col]] ~ dat$zone)
        
        # epsilon-squared effect size for Kruskal-Wallis
        n <- nrow(dat)
        k_groups <- n_distinct(dat$zone)
        H <- as.numeric(test$statistic)
        eps2 <- (H - k_groups + 1) / (n - k_groups)
        
        out[[k]] <- tibble(
          dataset = ds,
          method = meth,
          nutrient = nm,
          n_points = n,
          n_zones = k_groups,
          statistic = H,
          p_value = test$p.value,
          epsilon2 = eps2
        )
        k <- k + 1
      }
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out) %>%
    group_by(nutrient) %>%
    mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    ungroup()
}

zone_kw_tbl <- kruskal_zone_validation(zone_val_tbl, val_var_lookup)
zone_kw_tbl
zone_trend_validation <- function(zone_val_tbl, val_var_lookup) {
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (nm in names(val_var_lookup)) {
    val_col <- val_var_lookup[[nm]]
    
    for (ds in unique(zone_val_tbl$dataset)) {
      for (meth in unique(zone_val_tbl$method)) {
        
        dat <- zone_val_tbl %>%
          filter(dataset == ds, method == meth, !is.na(zone), !is.na(.data[[val_col]])) %>%
          mutate(zone_num = as.numeric(zone))
        
        if (nrow(dat) < 5 || n_distinct(dat$zone_num) < 2) next
        
        test <- suppressWarnings(cor.test(dat$zone_num, dat[[val_col]], method = "spearman"))
        
        out[[k]] <- tibble(
          dataset = ds,
          method = meth,
          nutrient = nm,
          n_points = nrow(dat),
          spearman_rho = unname(test$estimate),
          p_value = test$p.value
        )
        k <- k + 1
      }
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out) %>%
    group_by(nutrient) %>%
    mutate(p_adj_BH = p.adjust(p_value, method = "BH")) %>%
    ungroup()
}

zone_r2_validation <- function(zone_val_tbl, val_var_lookup) {
  out <- list()
  k <- 1
  
  for (nm in names(val_var_lookup)) {
    val_col <- val_var_lookup[[nm]]
    
    for (ds in unique(zone_val_tbl$dataset)) {
      for (meth in unique(zone_val_tbl$method)) {
        
        dat <- zone_val_tbl %>%
          filter(dataset == ds, method == meth, !is.na(zone), !is.na(.data[[val_col]])) %>%
          mutate(zone = factor(zone))
        
        if (nrow(dat) < 5 || n_distinct(dat$zone) < 2) next
        
        mod <- lm(dat[[val_col]] ~ zone, data = dat)
        r2 <- summary(mod)$r.squared
        
        out[[k]] <- tibble(
          dataset = ds,
          method = meth,
          nutrient = nm,
          n_points = nrow(dat),
          zone_r2 = r2
        )
        k <- k + 1
      }
    }
  }
  
  bind_rows(out)
}

  #nutrient takeaways:
    #all six zone maps significantly separated validation P after BH correction
  
      #Independent 0–15 cm validation data showed that the cluster-derived amendment-priority zones were most successful at capturing phosphorus variation, with all six dataset-by-method zone maps significantly separating validation P and several explaining substantial independent variance. Zinc also showed consistent but weaker support, while the lime buffer variables were most strongly represented in the composite-based zone maps, especially under ordinary kriging. In contrast, Ca, K, Mg, and Mn showed comparatively weak validation, suggesting that the multinutrient zones were not equally effective for all nutrients. Overall, the validation indicates that the zones are most useful as representations of broad phosphorus and fertility-priority structure rather than universal surrogates for every soil property.
  #SP vs COMP:
      #SP did better in P validation, COMP did better in LBC (even though it was not used in clustering, interesting...) 
  #OK vs RF vs RK:
      #SP RF and SP RK were the strongest for validation P, also Zn
      #COMP OK was the strongest for validation LBCs, despite no LBC in clustering, interestingly....
      #OK consistently looks like the weakest option for the zone-validation step, especially under SP.
      #RF strongest for SP P
      #RK is the most balanced across SP and COMP!
```

```{r save}
sf::st_write(soil_SP_cov, "../outputs/checkpoints/vectors/soil_SP_cov.gpkg", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
sf::st_write(soil_COMP_cov, "../outputs/checkpoints/vectors/soil_COMP_cov.gpkg", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
sf::st_write(ap_val_sf, "../outputs/checkpoints/vectors/ap_val_sf.gpkg", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
sf::st_write(sp_plus_val, "../outputs/checkpoints/vectors/sp_plus_val.gpkg", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)
sf::st_write(comp_plus_val, "../outputs/checkpoints/vectors/comp_plus_val.gpkg", delete_dsn = TRUE, quiet = TRUE)

for (ds in c("SP", "COMP")) {
  for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
    for (v in soil_vars) {
      obj <- final_ensemble_rasters[[ds]][[meth]][[v]]
      if (is.null(obj) || is.null(obj$mean)) next
      
      terra::writeRaster(
        obj$mean,
        filename = paste0("../outputs/checkpoints/rasters/ensemble_mean/", ds, "_", meth, "_", v, "_mean.tif"),
        overwrite = TRUE
      )
      
      terra::writeRaster(
        obj$sd,
        filename = paste0("../outputs/checkpoints/rasters/ensemble_sd/", ds, "_", meth, "_", v, "_sd.tif"),
        overwrite = TRUE
      )
    }
  }
}

for (ds in c("SP", "COMP")) {
  for (meth in c("RF", "OK", "RK")) {
    z_raw <- management_zone_rasters[[ds]][[meth]]
    if (!is.null(z_raw)) {
      terra::writeRaster(
        z_raw,
        filename = paste0("../outputs/checkpoints/rasters/zones_raw/", ds, "_", meth, "_zones_raw.tif"),
        overwrite = TRUE
      )
    }
    
    z_pri <- relabeled_management_zone_rasters[[ds]][[meth]]
    if (!is.null(z_pri)) {
      terra::writeRaster(
        z_pri,
        filename = paste0("../outputs/checkpoints/rasters/zones_priority/", ds, "_", meth, "_zones_priority.tif"),
        overwrite = TRUE
      )
    }
  }
}
```
